reviews.author: Janeen G
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Marvin, his workers and his entire shop! After dealing with ongoing issues from a previous mechanic, I brought my car here, and they were able to diagnose and fix EVERY single problem. The team was professional, honest, transparent, thorough, EXTREMELY DETAIL ORIENTED and clearly very knowledgeable. They took the time to explain what was wrong and what needed to be done every step of the way. My car is now running better than it has in years! I finally feel confident and safe on the road again. Highly recommend to anyone looking for reliable and skilled mechanics! You will not be disappointed!!! Thank you Marvin and team!

reviews.author: Luis Quelix
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of taking my 2013 BMW M5 to Torque Auto Repair, and I cannot express how impressed I am with their service. From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. The owner Marvin assisted me personally, quickly diagnosing the issue with my vehicle and explaining everything in detail, making sure I understood what needed to be done. The repair was completed in a timely manner, and my M5 is now running better than ever. Their professionalism and expertise are truly unmatched. I highly recommend Torque Auto Repair to anyone in need of vehicle repairs.

reviews.author: Gee e
reviews.text: Avoid this place at all costs, especially if you have a European car. They take forever to fix simple issues, use junkyard parts, and falsely claim they're from the manufacturer. Save yourself the trouble and steer clear to avoid wasting time, money, and dealing with unnecessary headaches.
